title: Concept: Unsafe deserialization via deserialize (julia) — review required
description: In julia, deserialize performs object deserialization: bytes select classes and set fields, so a hostile payload can drive gadget chains or execute callbacks. The julia-specific remedy is data-only decoding via a typed data format.
applicability: julia codebases decoding persisted or received bytes through deserialize; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Object injection leading to code execution or state corruption when hostile bytes reach the sink; HIGH severity because payloads are compact and often unauthenticated.
